title: NAAIL V1 Human Ground-Truth Protocol
scope: Protocol preparation only; no coding, data retrieval, case selection, scoring, or scientific conclusion is authorized.

governance.execution_gate: Human POC approval plus Claude approval of this protocol and a recorded pre-data freeze are required before execution.
governance.one_authoritative_run: One agreement calculation and one adjudication release are permitted for each frozen label set and protocol version.
governance.human_authority: Humans approve gates and final scientific judgments; the operator administers files and deterministic checks only.

prior_exposure.operator_role: Protocol author and repository operator only.

roles.adjudicator: Reviews locked disagreements only after reliability is computed; must not be either original coder for the item.
roles.data_custodian: Randomizes item identifiers, controls the blinding key, and releases only the permitted coding packet.
roles.operator: Validates schemas and computes preregistered metrics from locked inputs; never authors probes or labels.

coding_units.holdout: One sealed probe package defined under the separately frozen B4 specification.
coding_units.real_case: One preregistered claim-evidence unit from a human-selected case.

label_model.rule: Objective and judgment-dependent labels remain separate in storage, reliability reporting, adjudication, and downstream analysis.

coder_may_receive: source materials needed to evaluate the unit
blinding.randomization: The data custodian creates a reproducible randomized item order and keeps the seed and mapping sealed until raw coder labels are locked.

reliability.undefined_kappa_rule: If kappa is undefined because eligible labels lack marginal variation, report it as UNDEFINED, preserve counts, and do not treat the threshold as met.
reliability.below_threshold_rule: Keep the affected ground truth PRELIMINARY and HUMAN_REVIEW; do not use it for confirmatory system claims. Any revised study requires a new frozen protocol version and a new label set.

freeze_must_predate: release of scored items to coders

prohibited_claims: A threshold written in advance guarantees reliable labels.
